messages:
omar: Quick heads-up 10:02 UTC we started seeing a spike in fncall validation rejects on the canary slice (x5). Most are routed to the degen fallback which spikes cost. Console sampling is near-zero so we have no raw payloads.

jess: Is it only the canary? Any customer impact reported? :eyes:

omar: Canary-only so far. No customer reports but routing churn and cost are concerning.

ben: I pushed validator:v2.8.0-canary with stricter union->array coercion this morning. That was intentional for canary.

claire: The coercion toggle disallows implicit scalar->array conversion. Some adapters might still send a bare string for attachments.

omar: Example sanitized log line: [10:04:12Z] route=fncall-eu-canary validator=validators:v2.8.0-canary outcome=REJECT reason="attachments expected array, got string"

jess: Console only exposes rollup counts. Can we quickly add a temporary panel breaking down rejects by validator_version, route, fallback_route, and sample_rate? Need to correlate.

ben: Requesting sample override: route=fncall-eu-canary event=reject sample=100% duration=15m. I can ship validators:v2.8.1 with a soft-coercion toggle and a backfill endpoint for debug samples.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting roll validators:v2.8.1 -> canary (owner: @ben)

jess: Approving sample override 100% for 15m. Enable redact pipeline and add console audit note. :white_check_mark:

product: product: We need to avoid canary-induced billing/capacity surprises. Propose a console "shadow-fallback" toggle for canaries that routes fallback to an observability sandbox (no billing, no quota) while preserving metrics.

ben: Will add routing_tag=shadow-fallback and emit metrics validation.reject_mode={hard,soft,coerced} and routing.fallback_type={shadow,real}. Also include a fallback_cost_estimate histogram.

claire: Dashboard inspector should show redacted payload + model reply + validator fingerprint and adapter id to triage adapter vs model vs validator.

omar: Short-term runbook: if samples show adapter emits wrong shape -> revert adapter; if model output deviates -> revert validator strictness and spin up targeted evals.

alert-bot: alert-bot: created incident INC-2026-777 "canary-fncall-validate spike" (owner: eng-platform)

jess: Ben/Omar post 2 redacted samples in this thread when backfill completes. Claire, please draft a short revert checklist and attach to the incident. :thumbsup:
